title: AI Research & Development Associate (AI/ML & Generative AI)
description:
SkillPod Academy is looking for a passionate **AI Research & Development Associate** with strong technical knowledge and excellent communication skills.

The role primarily involves **training and mentoring students in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI**, along with exploring emerging AI technologies and developing practical AI projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct interactive AI/ML and Generative AI training sessions.
* Deliver practical coding sessions, workshops, and technical demonstrations.
* Guide and mentor students in real-world AI projects.
* Develop AI applications, prototypes, and practical learning materials.
* Prepare assignments, assessments, and technical presentations.
* Research emerging AI technologies and keep training content updated.

**Required Skills**

* Strong Python programming skills.
* Good understanding of AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.
* Knowledge of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, NLP, and Computer Vision.
* Familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
* Understanding of RAG, AI APIs, and AI application development.
* **Excellent English communication, presentation, and teaching skills.**

**Qualifications**

B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Sc. / M.Tech in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related fields.

**Freshers with strong AI projects, excellent communication skills, and an interest in teaching are encouraged to apply.**

**Preferred Candidate**

A technically skilled AI enthusiast who enjoys developing AI solutions, sharing knowledge, and mentoring aspiring AI professionals.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

Build and ship AI-powered features and automation workflows as part of the offshore AI engineering pod, extending the organization's LLM-based sales, CRM, and operations tooling under the direction of the Dubai-based AI Engineering team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop LLM-powered features, chat assistants, and automation workflows
* Implement RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, citation
* Write and iterate on prompts, tool definitions, and agent workflows.
* Integrate AI features with Salesforce, ERP, and platform APIs
* Build evaluation scripts and monitor model output quality and cost
* Collaborate closely with the Dubai AI Engineering team across time zones

**Tech Stack**

* Languages: Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* LLM APIs: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI
* Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Anthropic Agent SDK
* Vector stores: pgvector, Pinecone, Azure AI Search
* Backend: FastAPI / Node.js, REST & GraphQL.
* Cloud: Azure, Docker; CI/CD via GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps

**Cutting-Edge AI Skills**

* Prompt engineering, structured outputs, and function/tool calling
* RAG pipeline construction and retrieval tuning
* Multi-step agent design and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration
* Building evaluation sets and monitoring for hallucination/quality drift

**Business Domain Exposure**

* The organization is a large-scale master real estate developer delivering mixed-use residential, commercial, and hospitality communities across multiple master-planned developments, alongside affiliated retail, wellness/fitness, food & beverage, hospitality, education, and property-management operating brands.
* Supporting AI features for sales/CRM automation and buyer-facing chat/search
* Working with property, pricing, and inventory data from the organization's master-community projects
* Coordinating with Dubai AI Engineering on grounding AI outputs against Salesforce/ERP data

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
* Practical experience building with LLM APIs and prompt engineering
* Understanding of vector databases and embedding-based retrieval
* Comfortable working with REST/GraphQL APIs and cloud services
* Strong async communication skills for distributed teams

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
* Exposure to CI/CD and containerized deployments
* Interest in enterprise SaaS/real-estate integrations

Pay: Up to ₹130,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* 4–6 years data science engineering, with applied AI/LLM project experience?

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Experience:

* AI/LLM project : 6 years (Required)
* Data science: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: JUNIOR SERVICE TECNICIAN
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and customer-focused **Junior Service Technician** to provide on-site technical support, installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair services for computers, workstations, servers, networking equipment, and other IT hardware. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on troubleshooting skills, good customer communication abilities, and the flexibility to travel to customer locations as required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Visit customer locations to diagnose and resolve IT hardware and system-related issues.
* Install, configure, upgrade, maintain, and repair desktop computers, workstations, laptops, servers, and related IT equipment.
* Troubleshoot hardware failures involving motherboards, CPUs, RAM, GPUs, storage devices, power supplies, cooling systems, and peripherals.
* Perform hardware replacement, upgrades, component-level troubleshooting, and system optimization.
* Install and configure operating systems, drivers, firmware, BIOS/UEFI, and required software.
* Diagnose and resolve system performance, booting, overheating, connectivity, and compatibility issues.
* Provide technical support for printers, monitors, UPS systems, and other IT peripherals.
* Perform preventive maintenance and health checks of IT systems at customer locations.
* Handle system installation, relocation, commissioning, and decommissioning activities.
* Assist with basic network troubleshooting, including LAN connectivity, switches, routers, Wi-Fi, and structured cabling issues.
* Conduct hardware diagnostics and testing using appropriate tools and methods.
* Coordinate with internal service, helpdesk, sales, and technical teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.
* Maintain accurate service reports, job sheets, service tickets, and records of parts replaced or issued.
* Record and verify serial numbers and asset details of systems and components during service visits.
* Handle warranty and RMA-related service activities and coordinate defective component replacements.
* Collect faulty components and ensure proper handover to the service/RMA team as per company procedures.
* Ensure all replaced parts and service materials are properly documented and accounted for.
* Explain technical issues and solutions clearly to customers in a professional manner.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior engineers or the appropriate technical team.
* Follow company service procedures, safety guidelines, ESD precautions, and customer site policies.
* Complete assigned service calls within the agreed service timelines and maintain high customer satisfaction.
* Be available for occasional travel and emergency/on-call support based on business requirements.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Computer Hardware, IT, Electronics, or a related field preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in IT hardware service, field support, desktop support, or technical service.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
* Experience in assembling, upgrading, repairing, and maintaining desktop PCs and workstations.
* Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, drivers, BIOS/UEFI, and hardware diagnostics.
* Knowledge of basic networking and troubleshooting is preferred.
* Ability to diagnose hardware failures and identify defective components.
* Good understanding of storage devices, RAM, CPUs, GPUs, PSUs, and cooling systems.
* Good communication and customer-handling skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple service calls.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations as required.
* Valid driving license and ability to travel locally is preferred.

**Preferred Experience:**

Experience in the following areas will be an added advantage:

* Custom-built PCs and high-performance workstations
* Gaming PCs and professional workstations
* Servers and server hardware
* GPU-based and AI systems
* Networking equipment and basic network troubleshooting
* CCTV and related IT infrastructure
* UPS and power-related IT equipment
* Hardware warranty and RMA processes
* Preventive maintenance contracts (AMC)
* On-site installation and commissioning

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of assigned service calls
* First-time resolution rate
* Customer satisfaction
* Reduction in repeat service calls
* Accuracy of service reports and documentation
* Proper handling and tracking of replaced components
* Compliance with service response and resolution timelines
* Quality of installation, repair, and preventive maintenance
* Effective coordination with internal teams

**Working Conditions:**

This is primarily a **field-based technical role** requiring regular travel to customer locations for installation, troubleshooting, repair, preventive maintenance, and system upgrades. The engineer may be required to work outside normal business hours occasionally based on customer requirements and critical service situations.

**Ideal Candidate:**The ideal candidate should be a **hands-on IT hardware professional** who enjoys troubleshooting and solving technical problems at customer locations. The candidate must be technically competent, customer-friendly, disciplined in service documentation, and capable of working under time constraints while maintaining high-quality service standards.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Product Engineer
description:
About Nutcracklab

Nutcracklab is an AI analytics company building intelligent products that help businesses make better decisions using data, predictive analytics and artificial intelligence.We are building a portfolio of AI\-driven products across multiple business domains and are looking for a **Founding Product Engineer** to help take these products from MVP and prototype stages into reliable, production\-ready systems.

Required SkillsMust Have

· **4\+ years of professional software engineering experience**

· Strong **Python** development skills

· Strong **SQL** skills

· Experience with **PostgreSQL** or equivalent relational databases

· Experience building **REST APIs**

· Experience with **FastAPI, Flask, Django or equivalent**

· Strong experience with **Pandas / NumPy**

· Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics or AI applications

· Experience with **Git/GitHub**

· Experience with **Docker**

· Experience deploying applications to a cloud environment

· Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills

· Understanding of software architecture and production engineering practices

Preferred

· Experience with **Microsoft Azure**

· Azure ML or equivalent ML deployment experience

· Experience with **Streamlit**

· Data engineering / ETL

· API and third\-party system integrations

· CI/CD and GitHub Actions

· Application monitoring and logging

· Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture

· Experience taking products from **prototype/MVP → production**

· Experience working in **retail, e\-commerce or other data\-intensive business domains**

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

· Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

· Can independently investigate and solve technical problems.

· Is comfortable working with incomplete or evolving requirements.

· Can make practical architecture and technology decisions.

· Can balance speed of delivery with engineering quality.

· Enjoys working across multiple technical areas rather than being restricted to one narrow function.

· Has strong product thinking in addition to coding ability.

· Is comfortable working directly with founders and customers.

· Is excited by the opportunity to build new products from the ground up.

Why Join Nutcracklab?

This is an early\-stage opportunity with significant technical ownership.

You will have the opportunity to:

· Build AI products from the ground up.

· Work directly with the founder.

· Influence architecture and technology decisions.

· Work across AI, data and product engineering.

· Take products from **idea → prototype → MVP → production**.

· Help establish the company’s engineering culture and technical foundation.

· Eventually help build and lead the engineering team as the product portfolio grows.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Application Development Manager
description:

Company Overview
  
  

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

Role summary
  
  

Leads delivery execution across the three delivery teams while operating as a senior, hands\-on technical leader above Technical Lead level. The role requires strong engineering depth, active involvement in technical decision\-making, sprint delivery health, capacity and staffing management, engineering quality standards, and cross\-team dependency resolution.
  
  

Key responsibilities
  
Own sprint delivery health, capacity planning and staffing management across all three teams
  
Set and enforce engineering quality standards across the delivery organization
  
Provide hands\-on technical leadership across architecture decisions, design reviews, code\-quality practices, and complex engineering issue resolution
  
Resolve cross\-team dependencies alongside the Agile Coach (RTE)
  
Coordinate release readiness and launch\-position verification against the SOW's committed deliverables
  
Act as the primary delivery\-management escalation point before issues are elevated to the Client Service Organization
  
Required skills \& experience
  
12\+ years engineering or delivery management experience across multi\-team software programs
  
Strong grasp of sprint delivery health metrics, capacity planning and staffing management
  
Experience setting and enforcing engineering quality standards across concurrent teams
  
Must be technically stronger than a Technical Lead, with hands\-on experience in modern application development, system design, architecture oversight, code reviews, and production issue resolution
  
Comfortable owning release\-readiness and launch\-position verification processes
  
Proven ability to mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers while remaining hands\-on enough to challenge solution choices and guide implementation quality
  
Experience escalating and resolving delivery risk in a client\-facing engagement
  
Preferred qualifications
  
Experience managing staffing/backfill across a 25\+ person delivery organization
  
Familiarity with AI/RAG delivery quality standards specifically
  
Education
  
  

B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or a related field, MBA preferred, or equivalent practical experience; PMP or PgMP certification an advantage.
  
  

Compensation
  
  

**Estimated Pay Range:**  

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
  
  

Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion
  
  

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
  
  

Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.
  
  

We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.
